name: GOV extended: ProxyCreated (Aave V3 PoolAddressesProvider)
description: Aave V3 PoolAddressesProvider: ProxyCreated(bytes32,address,address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity info. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
